chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Amir Al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: 'Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) ordered us to meet the people of disobedience with unfriendly faces.'

key_terms.وُجُوهٍ مُكْفَهِرَّةٍ: Unfriendly/stern faces (literally darkened faces indicating displeasure)

ai.seo_question: What is the proper demeanor when encountering people of sin according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi highlights the principle of 'Ghadd al-Wajh' (furrowing the brow) as a non-verbal manifestation of 'Nahy an al-Munkar' (forbidding the evil), emphasizing that visible displeasure serves as a spiritual deterrent. In Shia scholarly tradition, this is often contrasted with the general command for kindness, illustrating that the demeanor toward sinners should reflect the gravity of their deviation from divine law. It underscores the social responsibility of the community to visibly distinguish between righteousness and transgression.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> ordered us all what we should meet the people of disobedience with an unfriendly face’.
en.sarwar: 9. Humayd ibn Ziyad has narrated from Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Sama‘ah from more than narrators from Aban ibn ‘Uthaman from ‘Abd Allah ibn Muhammad who has said the following:

“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that once a man from Khath‘am came to the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, and asked, ‘O Messenger of Allah, what is most virtuous in al-Islam ? 5 He (the Messenger of Allah) replied, ‘It is belief in Allah . 5 He then asked, ‘What is most virtuous thereafter ? 5 He, the Messenger of Allah, replied, ‘It is maintaining good relations with relatives . 5 He asked, ‘What is most important thereafter ? 5 He, the Messenger of Allah, replied, ‘It is asking others to do what is good and prohibit them to commit evil . 5 The narrator has said that the man then asked, ‘What is the most hated act in the sight of Allah ? 5 He, the Messenger of Allah, replied, ‘It is considering things as partners of Allah . 5 He then asked, ‘What is most hated thereafter ? 5 He, the Messenger of Allah, replied, ‘It is cutting off good relations with relatives . 5 He then asked, ‘What is most hated thereafter ? 5 He, the Messenger of Allah, replied, ‘It is asking people to commit evil and prohibit them from doing good . 555
